verdict.rationale: Sentry maintains official SDKs across many languages and engines, including Python, Rust, Unity, Unreal and Godot. It provides step-by-step per-platform SDK install guides and a five-line drop-in setup, and a one-command installer teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok to install and configure the SDK. Community users report building deep integrations on top of it. Missing for 10: evidence of an official SDK or typed client for the management web API, and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at any candidate path).
